name: David Duke
role: American white nationalist, former Ku Klux Klan leader and Louisiana state representative (1989-1992)
summary: Duke is an American white supremacist and Holocaust denier who advocates racial separation, sharply restricted immigration and a conspiratorial view of Jewish power. Economically he favours abolishing the income tax and workfare, and he defends gun rights while opposing free trade and foreign aid.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: He opposes hate-speech and 'political correctness' laws as suppression of free speech (chs. 39, 40).

limit-guns.rationale: His platform chapter defends the 'inviolate right to keep and bear arms' against gun control.

traditional-family.rationale: Chapter 14 says nothing is more important to society than the healthy and happy family and criticises feminism for undermining homemaking.

abortion-legal.rationale: Chapters 14 and 24 condemn abortion on demand, calling it a 'devastation' for women and a tool lowering the birthrate of the White majority.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: He opposes affirmative action, quotas and compensatory programs as anti-White discrimination (chs. 38, 40).

preserve-national-culture.rationale: He presents defending the heritage of Western Christian civilization as central to his cause.

reduce-immigration.rationale: He calls for 'severely restricting legal immigration' and ending illegal immigration (chs. 13, 40).

empower-international-orgs.rationale: His platform chapter attacks the 'New World Order' and international bodies as a threat to national sovereignty.

free-trade.rationale: Chapter 20 and his platform attack free trade deals as serving international finance against American workers.

nation-first.rationale: His platform chapter puts 'America First' ahead of global arrangements.

right-to-secede.rationale: Chapter 3 defends the Southern states' constitutional right to secede.

ethnic-nation.rationale: He says one-race societies are more stable and calls for separation 'on this continent or elsewhere' (chs. 12, 13).

hereditarian-race.rationale: Chapters 5-10 argue that racial differences in intelligence and behavior are mainly inherited.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: He calls Israel a 'nakedly supremacist' state (My Awakening ch. 22) and Jewish Supremacism has a chapter titled 'Israel: A Supremacist State'.

work-for-welfare.rationale: As a Louisiana legislator he co-authored a workfare bill, which he describes in My Awakening (ch. 38) as requiring able-bodied recipients to work.

elite-replacement.rationale: Chapter 24 says Jews promote mass non-European immigration with the 'blunt desire' of dissolving the White race in the West.

heritable-defect-limits.rationale: Chapter 39 endorses eugenic policy discouraging reproduction by those with heritable defects.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: He opposes race mixing as damaging to racial heritage and argues for racial separation (chs. 12, 14).

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: Chapter 13 describes multiculturalism as a source of conflict and 'tyranny' and praises one-race societies.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: He holds that Western civilization was created by Europeans and is superior to the cultures of other races (chs. 10, 11).

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: His platform chapter calls for stopping foreign aid to the Third World.

central-bank-independence.rationale: His platform chapter calls to 'take control of the Federal Reserve from the bankers'.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: As a Louisiana legislator he introduced a bill to end race-based preferences in state hiring and contracting (reported by the Christian Science Monitor).

slavery-not-civil-war-cause.rationale: Chapter 3 presents the Civil War as about tariffs and states' rights rather than slavery.

pronatalist-incentives.rationale: Chapter 14 says it must be made possible for women to choose homemaking and child rearing 'no matter the cost', and chapter 39 urges higher birthrates among the gifted.

minority-conspiracy.rationale: Chapters 15-25 of My Awakening and the whole of Jewish Supremacism argue that Jews conspire to dominate media, finance and government against the Western nations.

holocaust-denial.rationale: Chapter 23 argues that the Holocaust as historians describe it, including the six million figure and gas chambers, is a myth.

racial-group-interests.rationale: He argues that European Americans must organise to defend their heritage and interests, as other groups do.

racial-pride.rationale: He calls for White pride and a 'European American' rights movement.

state-arms-monopoly.rationale: He defends the individual right to keep and bear arms in his platform chapter, opposing a state monopoly on arms.

race-social-construct.rationale: Chapters 5-10 treat race as a biological reality, and he rejects the claim that it is a social construct.

race-based-immigration-restrictions.rationale: He argues that non-European immigration is dissolving the White majority and that immigration should serve the European-American heritage (chs. 13, 24, 39).

abolish-income-tax.rationale: His platform chapter says 'I would dismantle the IRS and abolish the income tax'.

evolved-behavioural-sex-differences.rationale: Chapter 14 argues that biology explains female and male patterns of behavior, citing Dorner's work.

notes: Positions come mainly from his own books. Not recorded: death penalty (he only notes racial disparity in who is executed), homosexuality in law (he says he does not equate it with criminality and calls its endorsement unwise), unions, conscription, school prayer, creationism, scripture-based law, political violence (he condemns Klan violence as strategically harmful, which is not a position on principle). Themes searched: economy, government, society, world, liberty. No missing statements.
